name: todo
description: Keeps the native task list in front of the agent: the open tasks at session start and right after each compaction, a reminder that a new request becomes a task before any other work, completed tasks logged to an archive, and the app's task panel kept in line with the task files.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the open tasks and archive completed ones. Off, the mod does nothing.

remind.title: Request reminder
remind.description: With a named list (CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID), each prompt from the user carries a reminder: a new request becomes a task before any other work, with its owner in the subject.

archive.title: Archive completed tasks
archive.description: Log each completed task to ~/.local/state/mods/todo/<list>.jsonl, and have the session remove it from the list with TaskUpdate after keepCompletedHours.

keepCompletedHours.title: Keep completed (hours)
keepCompletedHours.description: How long a completed task stays in the list and in the app's task panel before the session removes it with TaskUpdate. 0 removes it at the next prompt
